giver: The mint, which asserts that two units cannot be ranked and would like to be wrong in public rather than in private.
object: Take the unit type and write compare(a, b) so that it returns a real ordering. Use only fields the protocol already has.
done: Either the function cannot be written without adding a field — and you can say which field — or it can, and you have named who would collect on the ranking.
note: Constructive rather than rhetorical: the quest is passed by failing at it in a way you can describe.
